description: Construction number 1096. The 376th Bombardment Group B-24D that overflew its base returning from Naples on 4 April 1943 and was found intact in the Libyan Sand Sea in November 1958. The remains were recovered in August 1994 by a team led by Dr Fadel Ali Mohamed and taken to Tobruk. Wrecks and Relics Online places the wreck at a museum in Tobruk city and refreshed the record 19 March 2025 while Wikipedia states it is at Gamal Abdel Nasser air base about 25 km south-west. The discrepancy is unresolved. This is a wreck rather than a restored airframe and pieces have been souvenired over the decades.
